_comment: Hand-written per-option purposes for the Klipper extensions, read out of the
modules rather than inferred from option names. Keyed as 'module:option'.
Only options whose module this agent has actually read appear here. An option
with no entry shows the source comment above it if there is one, and otherwise
shows nothing - a blank is honest, a guessed purpose is not.
gen_extensions_reference.py merges this into CONFIG.md, so regeneration does
calibrate_shaper_config:shaper_freq_x: Input shaper frequency for X, in Hz, as measured by the calibration.
calibrate_shaper_config:shaper_freq_y: Input shaper frequency for Y, in Hz.
calibrate_shaper_config:shaper_type: Input shaper algorithm to save for both axes, when they share one.
calibrate_shaper_config:shaper_type_x: Input shaper algorithm for the X axis, overriding shaper_type.
calibrate_shaper_config:shaper_type_y: Input shaper algorithm for the Y axis, overriding shaper_type.
gcode_shell_command:command: Shell command this section exposes to G-code. Required: the section exists only to name a command.
gcode_shell_command:timeout: Seconds before the command is abandoned, so a hung process cannot block G-code indefinitely.
gcode_shell_command:verbose: Whether the command's output is echoed to the console.
motor_constants:deprecated: Marks a database entry as superseded, so it can be kept for compatibility while being discouraged.
motor_constants:holding_torque: Motor holding torque in Nm, from its datasheet. Used by TMC autotune to compute drive settings.
motor_constants:inductance: Winding inductance in henries, from its datasheet.
motor_constants:max_current: Motor rated maximum current in amps, from its datasheet.
motor_constants:motor: Name of the motor this section describes, matched against the motor database.
motor_constants:resistance: Winding resistance in ohms, from its datasheet.
motor_constants:steps_per_revolution: Full steps per revolution. A choice of 200 (a 1.8 degree stepper) or 400 (0.9 degree); no other value is accepted.
nebulaos_bed_soak:filename: File remembering the switch state across Klipper restarts.
nebulaos_bed_soak:pin: Output pin name the bed warp soak switch is exposed as, so SET_PIN can toggle it.
nebulaos_bed_tram:max_shim: Largest total shim the procedure will ask for. Beyond this the bed needs mechanical attention rather than shimming.
nebulaos_bed_tram:max_tries: How many adjustment rounds to attempt before reporting that it is not converging.
nebulaos_bed_tram:min_improvement: Improvement below this counts as no improvement, so a round that changed nothing is detected rather than repeated.
nebulaos_bed_tram:samples: Probe samples averaged per corner, trading time against noise.
nebulaos_bed_tram:shim_step: Thickness of one shim step, used when the guidance tells you how much to add at a corner.
nebulaos_bed_tram:state_path: File holding tramming state between runs, so a procedure can resume and results survive a restart.
nebulaos_bed_tram:tolerance: How close the four corners must come, in millimetres, before tramming is considered done.
nebulaos_beeper:channel: PWM channel within that controller that the buzzer is wired to.
nebulaos_beeper:click_duration_ms: Length of that touch click, in milliseconds.
nebulaos_beeper:click_duty: Loudness of the touch click, separate from duty so taps can be much quieter than alert beeps.
nebulaos_beeper:click_frequency: Pitch in Hz of the short click played when the touchscreen is tapped.
nebulaos_beeper:default_song: Melody used when NEBULAOS_PLAY_TUNE is called without naming one.
nebulaos_beeper:duty: Default PWM duty cycle, which sets loudness. Also the default for NEBULAOS_BEEP's DUTY parameter. Capped at 0.5 because a square wave is loudest at half duty.
nebulaos_beeper:max_beep_ms: Upper bound on a single NEBULAOS_BEEP, so a bad DURATION cannot leave the buzzer sounding indefinitely.
nebulaos_beeper:max_queue_seconds: Upper bound on how much queued sound may be pending, so repeated requests cannot build an unbounded backlog.
nebulaos_beeper:max_tune_seconds: Upper bound on a melody's total length when the printer is idle.
nebulaos_beeper:max_tune_seconds_printin: Upper bound on a melody's length while a print is running, normally lower than the idle limit.
nebulaos_beeper:pwmchip: Sysfs directory of the PWM controller driving the buzzer.
nebulaos_beeper:songs_file: File of named melodies that NEBULAOS_PLAY_TUNE can play by name.
nebulaos_calibration:bed_mesh_profile: Name of the bed mesh profile that auto calibration writes.
nebulaos_calibration:down_min_z: Lowest Z a downward probing move may reach, bounding the search.
nebulaos_calibration:esteps_commanded_le: Length of filament the E-steps calibration asks the extruder to feed, which you then measure.
nebulaos_calibration:esteps_max_correcti: Largest correction the E-steps calibration will apply, so a mis-measurement cannot produce an absurd step value.
nebulaos_calibration:horizontal_move_z: Height the toolhead travels at between probe points, clearing the bed and any print.
nebulaos_calibration:max_repeatability_r: Largest spread between samples at one point before the result is rejected as unrepeatable.
nebulaos_calibration:max_repeatability_s: Largest standard deviation across samples before the result is rejected.
nebulaos_calibration:min_accepted_sample: Fewest samples that must succeed for a point to be accepted.
nebulaos_calibration:pid_hotend_target: Nozzle temperature used for the hotend PID calibration.
nebulaos_calibration:pro_cnt: Number of probe samples taken per point.
nebulaos_calibration:probe_lift_speed: Speed of the lift after each probe touch.
nebulaos_calibration:reference_y: Y coordinate of the canonical physical bed reference point, paired with reference_x.
nebulaos_calibration:shaper_accel_per_hz: Acceleration per Hz used by the input shaper test, passed through to Klipper's own shaper calibration.
nebulaos_calibration:shaper_graph_config: Directory the graphs are exposed under in the config tree, so Mainsail can serve them.
nebulaos_calibration:shaper_graph_dir: Directory where input shaper graphs are written for the screen to display.
nebulaos_calibration:thermal_soak_second: How long to hold temperature before probing, so the machine is thermally settled.
nebulaos_calibration:travel_speed: Speed for moves between probe points, where no contact is being made.
nebulaos_calibration:z_offset_reference_: Reference nozzle temperature the Z offset is calibrated at, since thermal expansion shifts it.
nebulaos_compat:klipper_path: Path to the Klipper checkout whose symbols are checked against that manifest at startup.
nebulaos_compat:manifest: Path to nebulaos-extensions.json, the manifest naming which modules and Klipper symbols this extension set requires.
nebulaos_load_cell_calibration:default_g: Weight offered on the keypad before you type your own.
nebulaos_load_cell_calibration:max_grams: Highest accepted bottle weight, guarding against a mistyped figure.
nebulaos_load_cell_calibration:min_grams: Lowest accepted bottle weight. The procedure is built around a filled 1.5 litre bottle weighed on a kitchen scale; too light a weight calibrates poorly.
nebulaos_load_cell_calibration:stable_dr: Drift above this means the reading has not settled, so the procedure waits rather than recording a moving value.
nebulaos_load_cell_calibration:window_se: Length of the averaging window for a force reading.
nebulaos_memory:child_oom_score_adj: OOM score adjustment applied to child processes, so the kernel kills a helper rather than Klipper itself when memory runs short.
nebulaos_memory:mlock: Whether to lock Klipper's memory so it cannot be swapped out.
nebulaos_power_loss_recovery:checkpoint_: Seconds between checkpoints during a print. Shorter loses less to a power cut and writes more often.
nebulaos_power_loss_recovery:eeprom_path: Sysfs path of the small EEPROM holding the durable checkpoint record - the only thing trusted as proof that a checkpoint fully landed.
nebulaos_power_loss_recovery:min_z_for_s: Height below which no checkpoint is taken, so a cut in the first moments of a print does not offer a useless recovery.
nebulaos_power_loss_recovery:physical_re: Whether a resume actually restarts printing. **Off by default**: with it off, NEBULAOS_PLR_RESUME restores state only. The source records that it stays off until it has passed a supervised power-cut test print on the machine in question.
nebulaos_power_loss_recovery:poll_interv: Seconds between checks of print state while deciding whether to checkpoint.
nebulaos_power_loss_recovery:resume_z_li: How far to lift Z before moving back to the interrupted position, so the nozzle does not drag across the part.
nebulaos_power_loss_recovery:sidecar_dir: Directory for the larger JSON checkpoint files, written and fsynced before the EEPROM record so a power cut cannot leave the two disagreeing.
nebulaos_power_loss_recovery:timelapse_f: Directory moonraker-timelapse keeps its frames in. Set it to preserve a timelapse across a power cut: on resume the frames from before the cut are set aside, and _NEBULAOS_PLR_TIMELAPSE_MERGE puts them back in front, renumbered without a gap, before Moonraker renders. Empty disables the handling, and the timelapse is lost on resume.
nebulaos_version:generation_file: File tracking the app generation, used to tell an image's own apps from separately updated ones.
nebulaos_version:version_file: File reporting the installed NebulaOS version.
nebulaos_z_adjust:filename: File storing the saved Z adjustment, so it survives restarts.
nebulaos_z_adjust:max_adjust: Largest total Z adjustment accepted. A saved or requested value beyond this is refused, treating it as a damaged file or a mistake rather than an intention.
nebulaos_z_offset_probe:contact_speed: Speed of the slow downward move that makes contact. Slower reads the touch more precisely.
nebulaos_z_offset_probe:force_safety_lim: Force above which the probe aborts, so a runaway contact stops rather than pressing harder.
nebulaos_z_offset_probe:load_cell_mode_f: File recording which load-cell mode is selected, shared with the load-cell mode extension.
nebulaos_z_offset_probe:retract_dist: How far to lift after a touch before the next sample.
nebulaos_z_offset_probe:sensor_type: Which load cell sensor backend to use.
nebulaos_z_offset_probe:tare_time: Seconds spent averaging the unloaded reading to establish zero before a touch.
nebulaos_z_offset_probe:trigger_force: Force in grams at which the nozzle is considered to have touched the bed.
nozzle_clear:bed_max_err: Allowance for bed position error. Also serves as the fallback hover height when vs_start_z_pos is unset.
nozzle_clear:clr_noz_len_x: Width of the wipe pad area, within which the two probe points are randomised.
nozzle_clear:clr_noz_len_y: Depth of the wipe pad area.
nozzle_clear:clr_noz_start_x: X corner where the wipe pad area starts. The default of 0 is deliberate: the pad sits partly off the near edge of the bed's own X origin.
nozzle_clear:clr_noz_start_y: Y corner where the wipe pad area starts.
nozzle_clear:clr_xy_spd: Speed of the wiping move itself - slow, because it is a dragging contact.
nozzle_clear:g29_down_min_z: Lowest Z the downward probing move is allowed to reach, bounding the search.
nozzle_clear:pa_clr_dis_mm_x: How far the nozzle is dragged along X during the wipe.
nozzle_clear:pa_clr_dis_mm_y: How far the nozzle is dragged along Y during the wipe. Zero means a straight X-only wipe.
nozzle_clear:pa_clr_down_mm: How far below the probed pad surface the nozzle presses while wiping. Negative presses into the pad, which is what makes the wipe contact.
nozzle_clear:pr_clear_probe_cnt: How many probe samples must agree at each of the two wipe-pad points before the wipe proceeds.
nozzle_clear:rdy_xy_spd: Travel speed used to get to the pad, much faster than the wipe.
nozzle_clear:vs_start_z_pos: Hover height above the pad before probing starts. Defaults to bed_max_err, a dual use that predates this option.
z_compensate:bl_offset: X and Y offset of the BLTouch from the nozzle, as two numbers.
z_compensate:hot_rub_temp: Nozzle temperature held while the nozzle is rubbed against the pad.
z_compensate:hot_start_temp: Nozzle temperature to reach before the wipe sequence begins.
z_compensate:noz_pos_center: **Accepted but not acted on.** The source records this as plausibly another XY reference point, with nothing confirming it - and notes that misapplying it would send the toolhead somewhere unintended. Read, not used, flagged rather than silently dropped.
z_compensate:noz_pos_offset: **Accepted but not acted on.** As noz_pos_center: plausibly an XY reference, unconfirmed, deliberately not acted on.
z_compensate:pumpback_mm: **Accepted but not acted on.** The source records this as plausibly a pre-wipe retract, unconfirmed, and judges that wiring untested E-axis motion into a probe and heat sequence is not worth the risk on a guess.
z_compensate:save_config_command: G-code command used to persist the offset when persist_offset is on. Normally Klipper's own SAVE_CONFIG.
z_compensate:speed: **Accepted but not acted on.** As tri_min_hold - read, unused, present because the real device sets it (5).
z_compensate:tri_max_hold: **Accepted but not acted on.** As tri_min_hold - read, unused, present because the real device sets it (2000).
z_compensate:tri_min_hold: **Accepted but not acted on.** Read only so Klipper does not refuse to start: the real device's [z_compensate] section sets it (1400), and Klipper hard-errors on any section option that is never read. The sensitivity-override mechanism it belonged to was removed with PRTouch in Phase 1.8B, and the native probe backend has no equivalent.
z_compensate:type_nozz: **Accepted but not acted on.** The source records its meaning as unknown. Read so Klipper starts; nothing uses the value.
z_compensate:z_offset_down_min_z: Lowest Z the downward probing move may reach during Z offset calibration.
